title: Apply EXP-0171's five defects and EXP-0174's DEF-0174-1; fold the 25 vacuous fields into match; enumerate the wrong-operand defect class
type: desk experiment -- NO device work, no dispatch to the neo / M4 GPU / M5

clean_room.provenance: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE (re-analysis of committed evidence) + PUBLIC

defects_re_derived.DEF-0171-1: CONFIRMED -- ilogic byte0 == (dst<<4)|0x0b; 15/15 observable destinations, 0 misses, both gated runs. APPLIED. Refinement found here: byte0 BIT 3 is a don't-care on this datapath (low nibble 0x3 shows the same dst<<4 behaviour for 15 of 16); recorded, NOT folded into the match.
defects_re_derived.DEF-0171-2: CONFIRMED with a SCOPE CORRECTION -- the three G17P bfloat anchors raise `unknown instruction length (byte0=0x31)`, but the blocker is isadb.py's LENGTH RULE, not the descriptors: bf_add/mul/fma_dst already claim those bytes with 12 match bits vs bf_alu8_var's 4. db.json half APPLIED (fmt enum gains 0x00 on three descriptors + notes); the isadb.py fix is REPORTED.
defects_re_derived.DEF-0171-3: CONFIRMED -- ibfe.sign_ext is 0/2 inert in BOTH the unsigned and the SIGNED anchor on three carriers x two runs, while byte+6 moves 254/256. APPLIED (semantics).
defects_re_derived.DEF-0171-4: CONFIRMED -- outmod bit7 is a SOURCE-READ control: nand writes 0xFFFFFFFF x128 while and/or/xor/andn write 0 x128, poison_out==0, sentinels intact, both runs. APPLIED (enum + semantics, 3 descriptors).
defects_re_derived.DEF-0171-5: CONFIRMED and stronger than reported -- subop 0x0f is not only emitted but ENCODABLE: the match leaves 2 free bits, so the legal set is {9,b,d,f} and the enum was 3 of 4 complete. APPLIED.
defects_re_derived.DEF-0174-1: CONFIRMED -- n3_mov byte+1 is (S<<1)|half, S = bits 1..7, aliasing period 64, no uniform file. Scored the two competing models against a host oracle: 32/32 vs db.json's 3/32, both plans, both runs; aliasing 128/128. APPLIED to n3_mov (hardware) and frame_marker (STRUCTURAL, unswept); NOT applied to mov_zext16, whose byte+1 is a different, HW-proven-inert field.

also_applied: DEF-0174-2 (byte+2 op selector, byte+3 bit0 destination half) + the emitter-ready n3_mov encoding, semantics only
DEF-0174-4: reg_move_c0's 'no validated GPR-to-GPR move' marked SUPERSEDED
DEF-0174-3: pad_operand observation recorded, classification unchanged
EXP-0173's fold: 25 zero-free-bit fields into match, names preserved in new per-descriptor `match_notes` blocks

measured_but_NOT_applied.ilogic + b_alu10_lof + b_alu10_loe full: corpus-neutral and population-conserving (b_alu10_lof 175->0, b_alu10_loe 52->0, ilogic 23->250) but the hardware evidence covers only opsel_hi == 1; orphans 24 rows. Orchestrator's call.
measured_but_NOT_applied.DEF-0175-1 mov_zext16 match tightening: adding its own HW-validated (byte+2 & 0xC7)==0 accept rule is corpus-neutral but reclassifies 80 mov_zext16 -> n3_mov (correct) AND 70 frame_marker -> mov_zext16 (an unresolved 0x43 collision). Needs its own experiment.

new_defects_found.DEF-0175-1: mov_zext16's match does not encode its own HW-validated byte+2 accept rule, so it claims byte+2 values the hardware rejects (including ilogic's 0x1f).
new_defects_found.DEF-0175-2: the shared A/B gate (EXP-0165/analysis/ab_gate.py, copied forward) runs roundtrip_test.py IN-PROCESS via runpy; `import isadb` resolves once, so every tree after the FIRST silently re-measures the first tree's database. It reported ALLPASS=True for a candidate that actually crashed. Fixed here by running each tree in a subprocess.
